correctness.rationale: At Ak=delta+mu, the displayed full five-compartment ODE has a nonnegative logarithmic Lyapunov function. Independent SymPy differentiation verified exactly Vdot=-mu(S-rho)^2/S-mu(L-(1-rho))^2/L+sigma R[1-rho^2/S-(1-rho)^2/L] (critical terms cancel). Cauchy Schwarz plus simplex forces Vdot<=0, and LaSalle yields DFE attraction. An irreducible infected 2x2 Metzler matrix has simple 0 mode (1,h) and stable complement, giving I/E->h, stable scalar filters yield R/E and both signed susceptible deviations. The positive inverse infected weight derivative converges to K/H; hence tE->1/K and all component 1/t and cumulative log limits. Exact symbolic fraction check for rho=1/2, other rates=1, alpha=5/3,beta=1 yields A=4/3,B=17/9,G=1/4,H=4/3,K=45/16. Fresh ODE integration to t=100000 agrees with all five leading coefficients within 0.006% relative error, not proof of all initial states.
residual_risks: Criticality Ak=a and initial infection E(0)+I(0)>0 essential for algebraic tail; zero-infection face has none. Positivity of all rates and invariant simplex essential. Numerical t=100000 is corroboration.
